Thanks everyone.

I put my statement in global.R. 

And yes, if I move the limit down locally I cannot upload.  

But moving the limit up on the server (to a value of -1) does not allow me to upload a file greater than 30MB

Hello,

I have tried to set the file size limit to be larger using for example:

options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 10000*1024^2)

But still I cannot upload a .csv greater than about 30MB which is limiting my application a lot. 

Thanks in advance.

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: File size limit on server
parts:
We will add support for 3.1.2 either today or tomorrow.  It was only released last Friday, and frankly we have been a bit surprised by how quickly people are upgrading to it.  

As for the Rproj.user problem, I am guessing you have a large .RData file in that directory that captures the workspace environment.  If you look at your environment pane, you might be able to identify which objects are the big ones. Removing them and saving the data on exit of the project should cut that size down dramatically.
